Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning cosmetology training and licensure requirements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to cosmetology training and licensure requirements;and amending RCW 18.16.090.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.16.090 and 2003 c 400 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Examinations for licensure under this chapter shall be conducted atsuch times and places as the director determines appropriate.Examinations shall consist of tests designed to reasonably measure theapplicant's knowledge of safe and sanitary practices and may alsoinclude the applicant's knowledge of this chapter and rules adoptedpursuant to this chapter. The director may establish by rule aperformance examination in addition to any other examination. Thedirector shall establish by rule the minimum passing score for allexaminations and the requirements for reexamination of applicants whofail the examination or examinations. The director may allow anindependent person to conduct the examinations at the expense of theapplicants. The director shall ((take steps to ensure that after completion ofthe required course or apprenticeship program, applicants may promptly p. 1 SHB 2237take the examination and receive the results of the examination))provide written and practical practice examinations for students ofschools regulated under this chapter prior to completion of therequired training hours. The director shall provide practiceexamination results to schools.
